shortDescription: Restore one or more Virtual Machines from Cohesity Protection Jobs

options.name: backup_id
options.description: Optional Cohesity ID to use as source for the Restore operation.  If not selected, the most recent RunId will be used

options.name: backup_timestamp
options.description: Future option to identify backups based on a timestamp Currently not implemented.

options.name: cluster
options.description: IP or FQDN for the Cohesity Cluster

options.name: cluster_compute_resource
options.description: If the cluster compute resource is specified, VM will be recovered to resource pool under the specified compute resource.

options.name: cohesity_admin
options.description: Username with which Ansible will connect to the Cohesity Cluster. Domain Specific credentails can be configured in following formats AD.domain.com/username AD.domain.com/username@tenant LOCAL/username@tenant

options.name: cohesity_password
options.description: Password belonging to the selected Username.  This parameter will not be logged.

options.name: datacenter
options.description: If multiple datastore exists, datacenter and cluster resource details are used to uniquely identify the resourcepool.

options.name: datastore_folder_id
options.description: Specifies the folder where the restore datastore should be created. This is applicable only when the VMs are being cloned.

options.name: datastore_id
options.description: Specifies the datastore Id where the files should be recovered to. This field is required to recover objects to a different resource pool or to a different parent source. If not specified, objects are recovered to their original datastore locations in the parent source.

options.name: datastore_name
options.description: Specifies the datastore where the files should be recovered to. This field is required to recover objects to a different resource pool or to a different parent source. If not specified, objects are recovered to their original datastore locations in the parent source.

options.name: endpoint
options.description: Specifies the network endpoint of the Protection Source where it is reachable. It could be an URL or hostname or an IP address of the VMware Protection Source.

options.name: environment
options.description: Specifies the environment type (such as VMware) of the Protection Source this Job is protecting. Supported environment types include 'VMware'

options.name: interface_group_name
options.description: Specifies the interface name to connect after restoring the VM.

options.name: job_name
options.description: Name of the Protection Job

options.name: name
options.description: Descriptor to assign to the Recovery Job.  The Recovery Job name will consist of the job_name:name format.

options.name: network_connected
options.description: Specifies whether the network should be left in disabled state. Attached network is enabled by default. Set this flag to true to disable it.

options.name: network_id
options.description: Specifies a network configuration to be attached to the cloned or recovered object. Specify this field to override the preserved network configuration or to attach a new network configuration to the cloned or recovered objects. You can get the networkId of the kNetwork object by setting includeNetworks to 'true' in the GET /public/protectionSources operation. In the response, get the id of the desired kNetwork object, the resource pool, and the registered parent Protection Source.

options.name: network_name
options.description: Specifies a network name to be attached to the cloned or recovered object.

options.name: power_state
options.description: Specifies the power state of the cloned or recovered objects. By default, the cloned or recovered objects are powered off.

options.name: prefix
options.description: Specifies a prefix to prepended to the source object name to derive a new name for the recovered or cloned object.

options.name: recovery_process_type
options.description: Specifies the recovery type.

options.name: resource_pool_id
options.description: Specifies the resource pool Id where the cloned or recovered objects are attached.

options.name: resource_pool_name
options.description: Specifies the resource pool name where the cloned or recovered objects are attached.

options.name: restore_to_source
options.description: Switch determines if VM is restored to original source.

options.name: state
options.description: Determines the state of the Recovery Job. (C)present a recovery job will be created and started. (C)absent is currently not implemented

options.name: suffix
options.description: Specifies a suffix to appended to the original source object name to derive a new name for the recovered or cloned object

options.name: validate_certs
options.description: Switch determines if SSL Validation should be enabled.

options.name: vm_folder_id
options.description: Specifies a folder Id where the VMs should be restored.

options.name: vm_folder_name
options.description: Specifies a folder name where the VMs should be restored.

options.name: vm_names
options.description: Array of Virtual Machines to restore

options.name: wait_for_job
options.description: Should wait until the Restore Job completes

options.name: wait_minutes
options.description: Number of minutes to wait until the job completes.
